title: Finch Circle Registry Completion Bonus — Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry
content:
The completion Finch Circle bonus follows the registrant's membership in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program and the tier it holds on the date the completion discount is redeemed, which is the date of the completion purchase entry, and is added, in percentage points, to the completion percent of an order line on which the registrant of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry redeems the completion discount (her or his own purchase record of a registry item still in ordered status). It is added only for a registry type that grants the Finch Circle completion bonus:

- when the membership is active at Finch Circle Icon, that tier's registry completion bonus percent applies;
- when the membership is active at Finch Circle Platinum or Finch Circle Diamond, that tier's registry completion bonus percent applies;
- otherwise — another tier, an inactive membership, no membership, or a registry type that does not grant the bonus — no completion Finch Circle bonus is added.

The registry completion bonus percent of each tier is a figure of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program tier schedule, read from the tier the membership holds.

### Registry types that grant the bonus

| Registry type | Grants the Finch Circle completion bonus |
|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | no |
| Graduation Registry | no |
| Housewarming Registry | yes |
| Baby Registry | yes |
| Anniversary Registry | yes |
| Wedding Registry | yes |

### Decision table

| Registry type grants it | Membership status | Tier on the date the discount is redeemed | Bonus added |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | active | Finch Circle Icon | the Icon tier's registry completion bonus percent |
| yes | active | Finch Circle Diamond | the Diamond tier's registry completion bonus percent |
| yes | active | Finch Circle Platinum | the Platinum tier's registry completion bonus percent |
| yes | active | Finch Circle Member, Silver or Gold | none |
| yes | not active, or no membership | — | none |
| no | any | any | none |

*Example (hypothetical):* a registrant with an active Finch Circle Diamond membership redeems on a Graduation Registry line — the registry type does not grant the bonus, so none is added; the same registrant redeeming on a Baby Registry line receives the Diamond tier's registry completion bonus percent.
